posters.title: FST sa Bacood
posters.alt: Announcement poster para sa Funeral Service Team ng Calvary Foursquare Church para sa November 4, 2026. Nakasaad ang schedule ng funeral service, meet-up at departure times, venue sa Holy Family Chapel – Ricass Court, program flow, mga assigned participants, at special tasks ng driver at sound system technician.
posters.description: A professional, vertically oriented announcement poster featuring a clean navy blue and light blue color scheme with white rounded panels. The poster presents the Funeral Service Team's schedule for November 4, 2026 (Wednesday), including the 7:00 PM church meet-up, 7:30 PM departure, 8:00 PM service, and venue at Holy Family Chapel – Ricass Court, Manila. It also displays a six-part program flow, assigned participants, and special task assignments for the FST service vehicle driver and sound system technician. The design uses clear typography, numbered program entries, and simple icons for dates, transportation, people, time, and location.
